graph.summary: Vasopressin → Vasopressin V2 receptor → von Willebrand factor secretion → von Willebrand factor → Coagulation factor VIII → Hemophilia A

evidence.snippet: We tested the hypothesis that DDAVP induces vWF secretion by binding to V2R and activating cAMP-mediated signaling in endothelial cells.
evidence.explanation: DDAVP (desmopressin), a vasopressin analogue, acts as a specific agonist at the vasopressin V2 receptor.

paper.title: Vasopressin-induced von Willebrand factor secretion from endothelial cells involves V2 receptors and cAMP.

evidence.snippet: These results indicate that vasopressin induces cAMP-mediated vWF secretion by a direct effect on endothelial cells.
evidence.explanation: V2 receptor activation drives cAMP-mediated von Willebrand factor secretion from endothelial cells.

paper.title: Vasopressin-induced von Willebrand factor secretion from endothelial cells involves V2 receptors and cAMP.

evidence.snippet: Vasopressin and its analogue 1-deamino-8-D-arginine vasopressin (DDAVP) are known to raise plasma von Willebrand factor (vWF) levels.
evidence.explanation: Secretion of von Willebrand factor from endothelial stores raises circulating plasma vWF levels.

paper.title: Vasopressin-induced von Willebrand factor secretion from endothelial cells involves V2 receptors and cAMP.

evidence.snippet: recent biochemical investigations have confirmed that VWF is a key partner for FVIII, playing significant roles in FVIII function, its production and its stabilization
evidence.explanation: von Willebrand factor binds and stabilizes coagulation factor VIII in plasma, sustaining functional FVIII levels.

paper.title: The factor VIII/von Willebrand factor complex: basic and clinical issues.

evidence.snippet: VWF serving as the carrier for FVIII. VWF indirectly influences secondary hemostasis by stabilizing FVIII and transporting it to the site of primary hemostasis.
evidence.explanation: By stabilizing and carrying factor VIII, von Willebrand factor sustains functional plasma FVIII levels.

paper.title: Abnormal von Willebrand factor secretion, factor VIII stabilization and thrombus dynamics in type 2N von Willebrand disease mice.
paper.journal: Journal of thrombosis and haemostasis : JTH

evidence.snippet: Desmopressin is a synthetic vasopressin analog that increases the plasma levels of coagulation factor VIII, von Willebrand factor, and tissue plasminogen activator.
evidence.explanation: Raising plasma coagulation factor VIII corrects the FVIII deficiency underlying hemophilia A.

paper.title: Desmopressin-related myocardial infarction in a patient with Wegener's granulomatosis: a case report and review of the literature.

evidence.snippet: has been approved for use in the prevention and treatment of hemorrhagic events during surgery in patients with hemophilia A
evidence.explanation: Vasopressin analogue desmopressin is approved to treat bleeding in hemophilia A via increased factor VIII.

paper.title: Desmopressin-related myocardial infarction in a patient with Wegener's granulomatosis: a case report and review of the literature.
